videos.title: The Green Way Outdoors
videos.description: Kyle and Jeff head to the nation's capital and the Chesapeake Bay to investigate the controversy surrounding cownose rays and their disputed impact on the crabbing industry. A crab distributor, a bowfishing guide who targets the rays, an animal rights activist, fishermen, and a restaurant owner share competing perspectives as the team explores how these migratory animals should be managed.

videos.title: The Green Way Outdoors
videos.description: Kyle and Jeff trace Ernest Hemingway's fishing legacy, hearing childhood fishing stories from his great-nephew in Michigan. They learn how Hemingway inspired Captain Darrin's Atlantic pursuit of Giant Bluefin Tuna, then recreate a tuna fight using century-old fishing equipment Hemingway helped develop. They finish by trout fishing in Ketchum, Idaho, where Hemingway spent his final years.

videos.description: Across the globe, certain locations seem to resist explanation; from Japan's infamous "suicide forest" and enigmatic Knights Templar tunnels, to a top-secret wartime compound in Virginia; each holds clues to mysteries that have endured for generations.

videos.title: History's Mystery Files
videos.description: Desperate to gain the upper hand, military powers have pursued weapons that sound like science fiction: bat bombs, a hidden death ray and bizarre schemes designed to control the weather.

videos.description: A miracle cure with a deadly catch; A romantic gesture explodes in a president's face; A simple home repair spirals wildly out of control; Sometimes the biggest disasters begin with the best intentions.

videos.description: How did a pet pig spring into action to save its owner's life? Which mysterious spirits became the unlikely heroes that turned the tide for a doomed flight? And what shocking move did a carjacker make to rescue a baby trapped in a scorching car? These are the wild, unexpected stories of heroes you'd never see coming.

videos.description: Mother Nature doesn't always play nice, whether it's a mile-long sinkhole, a biblical swarm of crop-killing grasshoppers or an invasion of rum-fueled monkeys running wild on the island of St. Kitts; stories where humans go head-to-head with nature.

videos.description: Exploring the Lake Michigan Triangle and many other wild and weird places, including a doll-filled island with a dark past, deadly gas-filled explosive lakes, caves that harbor deadly viruses and a haunted place in the United States.

videos.description: History is full of mischief-makers, like the drunken pilot who steals a plane to win a bar bet; or the athlete who secretly mails himself across the world in a crate; how about the Houdini of orangutans who not only outsmarts every zookeeper, but inspires other apes to do it too; from pranksters to felons, these are history's most outrageous rule-breakers.

Men and women who have been impacted by the Turning Point ministry also share their stories with viewers. During the month of December, "Turning Point" usually features special Christmas programming.

videos.title: Sitting Bull

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: Awe-inspiring and mysterious, the pyramids of Egypt are significant wonders of the ancient world; more than 4,000 years old, they are celebrated architectural marvels, but no one fully understands how they were built or why.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: In a perfectly planned robbery, thieves steal half a billion dollars in masterpieces from the Gardner Museum in Boston; it's been three decades since the brazen heist, and an exhaustive search has failed to recover the stolen goods.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: It's one of the most legendary monsters said to be lurking in the vast open seas. With stories going back hundreds of years, this elusive creature has terrorized sailors and baffled scientists. Is this predator the stuff of legend... or could the Kraken be real?

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: The ancient ruler who amassed a fortune estimated to be worth 120 trillion in today's dollars; Genghis Khan hide his riches so well that to this day no one has unearthed them; 800 years later the fate of his treasure remains a mystery.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: The Titanic's tragic story captures the imagination of the public and experts of all kinds, who, decades after the ship's demise, still seek answers; a look into new evidence that might reveal more about how and why the Titanic sank.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: The death of one of history's most enigmatic rulers, Egypt's King Tutankhamun remains shrouded in mystery 3300 years later. Scientific advancements may be getting us closer to the identity of King Tut's killer.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: At the end of World War II, many Nazi officials are captured and tried for their crimes; but one of the architects of the Holocaust, Adolf Eichmann, slips through the cracks, repeatedly eluding Nazi hunters from around the globe.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
videos.description: In July 1996, one of the worst aviation disasters in American history leaves 230 people dead and countless questions unanswered; it's a tragedy that changes the aviation industry forever.

videos.title: History's Greatest Mysteries
